name: Sprite Inventory
author: neostryder
description:
A worked example of ModPlugin.screen: it draws the inventory and equipment as a grid of item cards instead of a lettered list, built from the screen's table rows rather than from its rendered text.

It takes those two screens and declines every other one, which is what the seam is for: a presenter reimagines the screens it has a better idea for and leaves the rest alone.
